summary: Acer Aspire 5 14 (Model: A514-54GQ) is a popular laptop model experiencing thermal throttling issues and occasional BSOD errors. The system's failure mode is primarily due to overheating, which can lead to reduced performance and increased battery drain.
detected_fault: Overheating due to inadequate ventilation and poor cooling system design.
suggested_solution: Ensure proper ventilation, adjust power settings, update drivers and BIOS, and monitor system temperatures.
